section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the findings of a single study that utilized a Standard Chinese translation of the BAS-2. The study confirmed the one-dimensional model's adequate fit, good internal consistency, and convergent validity, noting significant associations between body appreciation scores and life satisfaction, self-esteem, and, for women only, weight discrepancy and BMI. It also found the body appreciation model to be invariant across sex, with no significant difference in scores between women and men, and compared scores with a Cantonese version of the BAS-2.
